newsitem.title: USA: Fed seen adding reserves via multi-day system RP.
newsitem.headline: Fed seen adding reserves via multi-day system RP.

text.p: The Federal Reserve Bank of New York is expected to add temporary reserves to the U.S. banking system on Thursday via multi-day system repurchase agreements, Fed watchers said.

"We're expecting a term system RP. My guess is that it's going to be a seven-day operation, but ... it could be anything from four to 14 days," said Dana Saporta, economist at Stone and McCarthy Research Associates Inc.
Saporta said she sees the Fed facing a $5.0 billion daily add need during the current two-week maintanence period.
Analysts at consulting firm MMS International Inc. are also expecting the Fed to add reserves via multi-day system repurchase agreements.
At 1100 EDT/1500 GMT, the federal funds rate was trading at 5-1/4 percent, in line with central bank's target.
